backup_readiness_check.marketingCopy: Most small businesses believe their data is backed up - until a computer dies, a ransomware attack hits, or an employee deletes the wrong folder and the 'backup' turns out to be nothing. The Backup Readiness Check determines whether your critical business data is actually backed up and recoverable. We identify what data matters, verify what backup solutions exist (or don't), check whether they're configured and running, and test whether a restore would actually work. You get a clear, honest answer about your backup posture - and what it would take to be protected.
bestFor: Businesses that assume their data is backed up but haven't verified it
Organizations with no backup solution at all
Companies whose backups have never been tested
Businesses preparing for insurance that requires backup evidence
customerOutcomes: An honest answer about whether your data is really backed up
Critical data identified and its protection status documented
Backup gaps found before you need the backup
A clear path to actual data protection

computer_backup_setup.marketingCopy: A single workstation can hold months of irreplaceable business work - proposals, quotes, customer files, financials - and most businesses have no backup for it beyond 'I think it's in the cloud.' The Computer Backup Setup configures or guides backup for one workstation so its data is protected and recoverable. We identify the important data on the computer, set up automated backup to a reliable destination, configure retention, and verify a restore works. That one computer's data goes from at risk to protected - automatically, without relying on the user to remember anything.
bestFor: Businesses with critical work on individual computers
Organizations that want workstation data protected automatically
Companies that have never verified a workstation restore
Businesses that want data protection for key staff computers
whatIsIncluded: Backup solution setup for the computer
customerOutcomes: Automated backup protecting that workstation's data
Verified restore capability instead of assumed protection
Retention configured so history survives
A protected computer without relying on user habits

microsoft_365_backup_setup_backup_recove.marketingCopy: Microsoft 365 gives you retention and recycling bins - not backup. If an employee permanently deletes mail, ransomware encrypts OneDrive files, or an insider wipes a SharePoint site, Microsoft won't restore it. The Microsoft 365 Backup Setup configures a proper backup solution for Exchange Online, SharePoint, and OneDrive with real point-in-time recovery. We select an appropriate backup platform, automate backup of your mailboxes, sites, and files, set sensible retention, and test a restore so you know it works. Your Microsoft 365 data finally gets the protection you've been assuming it has.
bestFor: Businesses that assume Microsoft 365 protects their data (it doesn't fully)
Organizations concerned about accidental deletion, ransomware, or insider threats
Companies that need mail, files, and sites recoverable beyond Microsoft's retention
Businesses preparing for insurance that requires backup evidence
customerOutcomes: Real automated backup of your Microsoft 365 data
Point-in-time recovery for mail, files, and sites
Verified restore capability instead of assumed protection
Backup evidence for insurance and compliance

nas_backup_setup.marketingCopy: A NAS holds your file server data, shared documents, and often your only copy of important files - and if it's not backed up, a single drive failure or ransomware event can wipe it all. The NAS Backup Setup configures backup for a local NAS or file storage target so its data is protected. We assess what's on the NAS and what matters, set up backup to a reliable destination with proper retention, configure it to run automatically, and verify a restore works. Your file server data gets real backup instead of existing only on the NAS itself.
bestFor: Businesses running a NAS without a backup of it
Organizations whose shared files exist only on the NAS
Companies that want file server data backed up automatically
Businesses preparing for insurance or ransomware protection
customerOutcomes: Your NAS data backed up automatically to a safe destination
Shared files recoverable if the NAS fails or is encrypted
Retention configured so history survives
Verified restore capability for your file server data

cloud_backup_setup.marketingCopy: Cloud backup is the simplest, most reliable protection for most small businesses - but only if it's set up for the right data, with the right retention, and actually working. The Cloud Backup Setup configures cloud backup for your business data and provides basic retention guidance. We identify the data that matters, set up automated cloud backup, configure retention, and verify it runs and restores. Your critical data goes off-site to the cloud automatically - protected against local failures, theft, and ransomware, and recoverable from anywhere.
bestFor: Businesses that want off-site, automatic data protection
Organizations that need their data recoverable after local failures
Companies that want cloud backup configured properly
Businesses preparing for insurance that requires off-site backup
customerOutcomes: Automatic off-site cloud backup of your critical data
Data recoverable after local failure, theft, or ransomware
Retention configured to protect your history
Verified, documented cloud backup

backup_restore_test.marketingCopy: A backup you've never restored isn't a backup - it's a hope. The Backup Restore Test performs a controlled restore from your backup and documents the results, so you know whether your data can actually be recovered when you need it. We select a set of data to restore, perform the restore in a controlled way, verify the recovered data is complete and usable, and document the outcome. If the restore fails, we find out now - not during a real incident. It's the test that turns backup from an assumption into verified protection.
bestFor: Businesses with backups that have never been tested
Organizations that want proof their restores actually work
Companies preparing for insurance or compliance that require tested backups
Businesses that want to find backup problems before an incident
whatIsIncluded: Recovered data completeness and usability verification
customerOutcomes: Verified proof that your backup can actually be restored
Backup problems found and fixed before a real incident
Documented restore testing for insurance and compliance
Confidence that your data is truly recoverable

backup_monitoring_plan.marketingCopy: Backups quietly fail all the time - a job stops running, a destination fills up, a credential expires - and most businesses don't find out until they need the data. The Backup Monitoring Plan is a recurring service that keeps your backups verified: automated backup status review, failure alerts, monthly status reports, and restore-test reminders. Each month your backups get checked, failures caught and escalated, and readiness maintained. It's the ongoing oversight that turns backup from a setup-and-hope situation into a monitored, verified, reliable process.

Organizations that can't afford to discover backup failure late
Companies that want monthly backup status visibility
Businesses that want restore testing kept on schedule

Restore testing kept on schedule
Verified, reliable backup protection month after month

disaster_recovery_plan_starter.marketingCopy: When a disaster takes out your systems - ransomware, a fire, a flood, a failed server - the businesses that recover have a plan, and the ones that don't lose weeks of time and revenue. The Disaster Recovery Plan Starter creates a plain-English recovery plan for your systems, data, contacts, and priorities. We identify the critical systems and data that must recover first, document the recovery steps, define the order and timeline for restoration, and record the key contacts. It's a practical recovery plan customized to your business - not a generic binder that sits on a shelf.

The Backup Starter Bundle builds your first real backup capability in one coordinated engagement: critical data discovery, one backup destination, a basic restore test, and instructions. The Backup Business Bundle delivers a comprehensive backup solution in one coordinated engagement: multiple devices and cloud accounts backed up, a scheduled monitoring plan, and quarterly restore testing. The Backup Resilience Bundle packages comprehensive backup protection into one coordinated engagement: workstations, cloud, NAS or server considerations, restore testing, and a ransomware recovery checklist. The Business Continuity Starter Plan identifies your critical systems, recovery targets, and continuity contacts. We work through which systems must stay up, how fast each needs to recover, and who the key contacts are for people, vendors, and recovery. The Emergency Contact Sheet creates a vendor, account, and contact list for outages, security events, and recovery. We help you compile the contacts that matter, organize them by scenario, and format it so it's usable under pressure. When something goes wrong, you reach for the contact sheet instead of searching your email history.

The Outage Response Plan creates concrete steps for the outages that hit small businesses hardest: internet, email, file access, and website failures. We document what to check, who to contact, how to communicate internally, and how to decide when to escalate. power_protection_review.marketingCopy: Power problems - surges, brownouts, and outages - quietly damage business equipment and corrupt data, and most small businesses have no UPS protection on the systems that matter. The Power Protection Review assesses your UPS and surge protection needs for critical equipment. We identify which systems need protected power (servers, network gear, computers, phone systems, cameras), evaluate your current UPS and surge protection, and recommend the right protection levels and sizing. internet_failover_setup.marketingCopy: When your internet connection fails, your phones, payments, email, and customer access can all stop at once - and without backup connectivity, you're down until the ISP recovers. The Internet Failover Setup configures backup internet or failover where it's available. We assess your options, set up backup connectivity, configure automatic or manual failover, and test that it works. Your business gains the ability to stay online through an ISP outage - with failover that's configured and proven, not just an unused LTE device on a shelf.

critical_account_recovery_kit.marketingCopy: If your domain registrar, email admin, website host, or cloud provider account gets locked out or compromised, can you get back in? We work through each critical account, document who controls it, how recovery works, and what the fallback options are, and store the information securely. tabletop_exercise.marketingCopy: The best way to find out if your incident response and continuity plans actually work is to walk through a scenario - before a real one happens. The Tabletop Exercise runs a ransomware, outage, or account compromise scenario with your leadership team in a controlled session. We present a realistic scenario, guide your team through their response decision by decision, and identify where plans, roles, and communications break down. You get a realistic picture of your team's readiness without the real damage - and an action list of what to fix before it's tested for real.
